summary: Independent review of the 6-row x 36-column SDRF (3 orthotopic MDA PCa 2b-luc xenograft mice vs 3 sham-injected controls, prostate-tissue sEVs, one label-free DDA run each on a Q Exactive HF-X) found no blocker or important issues. Validator, offline hallucination check and score pass; all controlled terms resolve; biological, sample-prep, instrument and search claims trace to the paper, PRIDE record and RAW headers. The per-file disease assignment (125-127 = PCa, 128-130 = Control) rests partly on an inferred Proteome Discoverer F-number order that cannot be re-checked locally; no evidence contradicts it. Minor findings only.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer subagent without producer transcript; producer report.md and evidence.json treated as untrusted claims; read only scratchpad/PXD070089/ and the spec/templates

spec_compliance.evidence: Active templates derived independently: mouse tissue, label-free DDA -> ms-proteomics v1.1.0 + vertebrates v1.1.0 (installed sdrf-templates; bundle template folder empty); both declared in comment[sdrf template]. All required columns of base, sample-metadata, ms-proteomics and vertebrates present (source name, assay name, technology type, technical replicate, data file, organism, organism part, biological replicate, disease, developmental stage, acquisition method, instrument, cleavage agent, label, fraction identifier). 36 columns on every row, no empty/whitespace-padded cells, no duplicate rows, unique assay names; column order characteristics -> assay/comment -> factor value; biological replicate numbering restarts per factor group as README requires; age '11W' matches {Number}{Unit}; collision energy '27% NCE' matches template pattern; modification parameters use NT/AC/TA|PP/MT syntax. characteristics[cellular component] is not in TERMS.tsv but is a GO-named custom characteristics column allowed by README 'Extending Templates'.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Resolved against offline OLS cache parquet files: MS:1002877 'Q Exactive HF-X'; MS:1001251 trypsin; MS:1000422 beam-type collision-induced dissociation; MS:1002038 label free sample; PRIDE:0000627 data-dependent acquisition; PRIDE:0000608 dithiothreitol (DTT); PRIDE:0000599 iodoacetamide (IAA); UNIMOD:4 Carbamidomethyl, UNIMOD:35 Oxidation, UNIMOD:1 Acetyl; NCBITaxon:10090 mus musculus; prostate gland (UBERON:0002367/BTO:0001129); prostate cancer (MONDO:0008315/DOID:10283); normal (PATO:0000461); adult (EFO:0001272); extracellular vesicle (GO:1903561); male (PATO:0000384). Labels/accessions match, none flagged obsolete. Free-text values (treatment, strain 'BALB/c nude') are allowed (TERMS.tsv: strain or breed = free text) and only raise validator warnings.

source_evidence.evidence: manuscript.txt (PMID 41243699, Proteomics 2026, doi 10.1002/pmic.70081 = PRIDE reference): 2.1 'murine PCa model (n = 3) and a control group (n = 3)', control 'administered an equal volume of culture medium', 'Four weeks post-injection, we excised the prostate'; 2.4 'MDA-PCa-2b-luc cells were implanted into the dorsal prostate lobes of 7-week-old male BALB/C nude mice' -> organism/strain/sex/age 11W (7W + 28 d, Results 'Day 28'); 2.5-2.6 sEV isolation from prostate tissue; 2.8 DTT/iodoacetamide/trypsin; 2.9 DDA, HCD, PD 2.2, 10 ppm / 0.02 Da. raw_header_check.json: all 6 RAW headers 'Q Exactive HF-X', method lfq_15cm_60min, nce 27 (PRIDE lists Q Exactive HF and paper 'Q Exactive Series'; RAW header is the stronger evidence and the files carry the HFX1 prefix). Table S1 (xls, header 'Protein, Gene, PCa 1-3, Control 1-3', 1362 proteins) contains only mouse accessions/gene symbols, supporting Mus musculus as searched organism. Per-file group assignment: F1 = HFX1_FPEP210040125-1A from export file name, Table S1 columns = F1..F6 in order (producer's numeric comparison; the 11 MB PeptideGroups export is not saved locally so this could not be recomputed), F2..F6 = 126..130 inferred from input order; every natural ordering (alphabetical, numeric, acquisition sequence) of the consecutively numbered files gives the same result and no evidence contradicts it. Acetyl protein N-term and fixed carbamidomethyl are stated only from the unsaved export; consistent with PD 2.2 defaults and the DTT/IAA protocol.

file_mapping.evidence: files.json / files_compact.json (URLs under .../2026/03/PXD070089/): 6 RAW files HFX1_FPEP210040125-1A.raw .. 130-1A.raw plus one SEARCH file HFX1_FPEP210040125-1A_PeptideGroups.txt. SDRF comment[data file] lists exactly the 6 RAW files, once each; assay names equal file stems; the search export is correctly excluded; no missing, duplicate or unmatched files.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed: 6 sources = 3 prostate cancer + 3 normal (paper n = 3 per group); biological replicate 1-3 within each group; technical replicate 1 and fraction identifier 1 on all rows (one RAW per sample, SDS-PAGE used only as QC before in-solution digestion); single factor value[disease] mirrors characteristics[disease]; treatment is fully confounded with disease (expected for this design) and not duplicated as a factor; constant columns (age, sex, strain, instrument, mods, tolerances) consistent with a single cohort and single acquisition method.

omission_safety.evidence: Checked every value for over-specification: age 11W derived arithmetically from stated 7-week implantation + 4 weeks; developmental stage 'adult' is a coarse, defensible inference for 11-week mice; disease kept at 'prostate cancer' rather than a more specific subtype; organism kept as host (Mus musculus) consistent with the mouse-only search database, and the human xenograft is disclosed in characteristics[treatment] rather than silently omitted; no invented per-sample values (no individual IDs, masses, dates). Material evidence not encoded (optional): human MDA PCa 2b cell-line origin of the tumour as a structured column, MS1 scan range 350-1500 m/z; see minor findings.

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock /tmp/sdrf_validate.lock parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -s annotations/PXD070089.sdrf.tsv -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates --use_ols_cache_only -> exit 0, 'only warnings' (3 free-text warnings: two treatment values, strain 'BALB/c nude'); sdrf-tools check --offline -> exit 0, Status CLEAN (0 hallucinated, 0 label mismatches, 0 UNIMOD swaps); sdrf-tools score -> exit 0, 100/100. Artifact SHA-256 unchanged before and after checks.

findings.location: rows 1-6, characteristics[disease] / factor value[disease] / source name vs comment[data file]
findings.message: Run-to-group assignment (125-127 = PCa, 128-130 = Control) depends on an inferred Proteome Discoverer F1-F6 -> RAW order and on a Table S1 <-> PeptideGroups comparison that cannot be recomputed from saved evidence (export not stored locally).
findings.evidence: sample_mapping.json 'F_to_raw': 'Not stated in any deposited file. Inferred ...'; only F1 = 125 is anchored by the export file name. No evidence contradicts the mapping and all natural orderings agree.
findings.correction: Keep as is, but state this inference explicitly in the PR description; if the PeptideGroups export or the authors confirm a different input order, reassign rows accordingly.

findings.location: rows 1-3, characteristics[treatment]; file-level (no characteristics[xenograft] / cell line column)
findings.message: The human MDA PCa 2b-luc orthotopic xenograft is encoded only as free text in characteristics[treatment].
findings.evidence: TERMS.tsv registers characteristics[xenograft] (EFO:0003942, free text); paper 2.2/2.4 name the cell line MDA PCa 2b (ATCC) and the BALB/c nude host.
findings.correction: Optionally add characteristics[xenograft] = 'MDA PCa 2b-luc orthotopic xenograft in nude mice' for PCa rows and 'not applicable' for controls (Cellosaurus CVCL_4748 could be cited).

findings.message: Column name is not a registered term in TERMS.tsv; it is permitted as a custom GO-named column but is not validated by any template.
findings.evidence: grep of TERMS.tsv finds no 'cellular component'; README 'Extending Templates' allows custom ontology-named columns.
findings.correction: Keep if the target repository accepts it; otherwise convey the sEV fraction via characteristics[enrichment process] or the source name.
